# DoomDeckLauncher (DDL)

> DoomDeckLauncher is a free, open-source, controller-first launcher for
> community DOOM mapsets on Steam Deck, powered by DSDA-Doom. It never
> bundles or downloads commercial base games; you bring your own legally
> owned DOOM base-game files (IWADs).

## Main pages

- [DoomDeckLauncher](https://doomdecklauncher.com/): product overview, features, install
  steps, requirements and questions answered.
- [Asset credits](https://doomdecklauncher.com/assets/credits.html): artwork, font and
  community screenshot provenance.

## Project documentation

- [Steam Deck guide](https://github.com/vittau/Doom-Deck-Launcher/blob/main/docs/steam-deck-guide.md):
  installation, updates and controller setup.
- [Source code](https://github.com/vittau/Doom-Deck-Launcher): GPL-3.0-or-later
  repository and contribution guide.
- [Flatpak research](https://github.com/vittau/Doom-Deck-Launcher/blob/main/docs/research/flatpak.md):
  upstream evidence for the signed, self-hosted remote.

## Notes

- The signed Flatpak is an experimental, self-hosted channel, not a
  Flathub listing.
- Requirements: a Steam Deck and legally owned DOOM base-game files
  (IWADs). DSDA-Doom is downloaded separately from its official upstream
  release inside the launcher.
- No Windows or macOS builds are published.
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later.
